title: 1.000 downloads on steam in 2 weeks!!
author: RubenPrende
selftext: Hello everyone, I created GRIDRUSH 100% using AI with claude code. The game has been made with claude code programming in GODOT and now after two patches correcting some minor bugs that spotted after multiple people was playing the game is looking even better. I will be glad to answer any questions you have about the development of the game and also if you want to play it you have a free demo on steam.

replies.author: RubenPrende
replies.body: What price will you put?? The demo is free, should I reduce the price??

replies.author: SaltAddictedMan
replies.body: Price it higher!

replies.author: Gramory
replies.body: I mean if you got 1k sales on this already you do you. Personally I would not touch something this simple unless it was free. Maybe for a dollar if it goes so viral it becomes one of those things that all your friends are doing and you're competing for highscore. I'm honestly curious what your price to profit curve would look like on this product. I'd be shocked if the optimal price is 5 dollars though. Gonna follow this just to keep an eye on the sales, congrats on the success.
